patterns.note: A dense, responsive grid of website thumbnails, each with a title below, serves as the primary content display, maximizing the number of examples visible.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with a large, bold, centered sans-serif heading for the page title, contrasted with smaller, lighter text for supporting information and navigation.
A stark monochromatic palette of white, black, and subtle light grays for the site's UI allows the diverse colors of the showcased website examples to stand out without competition.
The top navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation elements like 'Styles' and 'About'.
A consistent, minimal footer layout across all pages features copyright information, a brief site description, and navigation links, all presented in a left-aligned block with ample vertical spacing.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport during scroll, ensuring primary navigation is always accessible without obscuring content.
Content is displayed in a flexible grid system that adapts to different screen sizes, presenting website examples as uniform cards with a title below, facilitating easy browsing.

Typography utilizes a clear hierarchy with a single sans-serif font, where the main page title is significantly larger and bolder than subheadings and body text, all centered for visual impact and a clean aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter supporting text and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing around the main page title and footer, while the content grid maintains a tighter, consistent spacing between items.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extreme visual minimalism and neutrality, which intentionally recedes to allow the diverse and colorful showcased website designs to be the sole focus. It acts as a pristine, almost invisible, gallery space for web design inspiration.
